items.title: Define and emit done_prepare closure progress labels
items.context: Implement M1 label output for post-validation done_prepare phases: evaluating DONE closure, checking review assurance, computing runtime-change status, checking clean tree, and producing DONE command. Keep labels as diagnostic progress only.
items.userSees: A long done_prepare closeout prints explicit progress lines after validation instead of going silent.

happy.desc: A done_prepare fixture that reaches post-validation closeout emits the M1 progress labels in human-readable output.

edge.desc: done_prepare --json keeps stdout parseable while progress/liveness output uses a safe side channel.

adversarial.desc: Progress labels are diagnostic only and do not mark DONE readiness or write gate evidence.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke asserts human done_prepare emits the required post-validation progress labels on the CLI liveness side channel.
Focused smoke runs done_prepare --json, JSON.parse(stdout) succeeds, and progress labels are asserted on stderr rather than stdout.
Focused smoke snapshots story metadata and verifies progress labels remain diagnostic: they do not write review, DONE, Authority, or gate evidence.

items.title: Add independent hard deadlines for heartbeating closeout phases
items.context: Implement M2 safety: every heartbeating post-validation closure phase has a bounded hard deadline independent of the global idle watchdog, so timer output cannot keep a genuinely hung phase alive indefinitely.
items.userSees: If a done_prepare closeout phase hangs, the CLI fails with an attributed phase-timeout diagnostic instead of silently running forever.

happy.desc: A slow but completing closeout phase emits heartbeat/progress and exits successfully before its phase deadline.

edge.desc: A closeout phase needing longer work is split into bounded checked steps or uses an explicit phase deadline below the global idle timeout.

adversarial.desc: A deliberately hung heartbeating closeout phase fails closed by its independent phase deadline even though heartbeat output continues.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke covers normally completing closeout phases and verifies progress output completes before the independent phase deadline.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Implementation gives every wrapped closeout phase a per-phase timeout with env override and a 240000ms default below the 300000ms global idle timeout.
Focused smoke deliberately hangs runtimeChange while heartbeat continues; done_prepare returns BLOCKED at runtimeChange with an attributed phase-timeout.

items.title: Add regression coverage for human and JSON liveness contracts
items.context: Add focused smoke coverage proving human output gains progress, JSON stdout remains parseable, and the new heartbeat/deadline behavior does not depend on B-783c activity-log persistence.
items.userSees: The focused smoke passes and documents that B-783c activity logging is a baseline, not a substitute for real-time done_prepare progress.

happy.desc: Focused smoke passes after npm --prefix packages/main run build.

edge.desc: If cli-engine activity logging or runtime root detection is untouched, thin-init-assets-smoke is not required for this story; if touched, it is run.

adversarial.desc: The smoke proves heartbeat output cannot satisfy review, delivery, DONE, Authority, or production gates by itself.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Build and focused smoke both passed after the implementation commit.
Diff touches done_prepare, command schema, package script, and focused smoke only; cli-engine activity logging and runtime-root detection were not modified, so thin-init-assets-smoke is not required.
Focused smoke proves progress/heartbeat output is diagnostic only and cannot satisfy lifecycle or Authority gates by writing evidence.
